correctness.rationale: The explicit free-lattice norm is reconstructed from the primary full-text source. A finite sequence ℓp/ℓq duality and per-coordinate Hölder extremizers prove the orientation-distribution formula in both directions. p=1 and p=∞ endpoints are separately established. Equality in |b_i|≤deg(i) gives exactly bipartiteness; the friendship source-neutral leaf count, group average, Jensen bound and explicit 2/3 orientation mixture establish matching upper/lower values for all real p. Vertex-transitive and majorization steps justify cycles and cliques. Rational orientation checks of finite instances passed; the full proof is not based on finite enumerations.

value.rationale: Graph total variation is a canonical lattice expression generated by edge differences, giving a motivated exact invariant across every finite graph. The result combines a finite but nontrivial orientation moment optimization, a sharp graph-structural equality theorem, an all-exponent exact norm family that is not vertex-transitive, and complete/cycle consistency tests. The equality mixture (2/3 source hub, 1/3 neutral) encodes meaningful structure beyond a textbook triangle inequality or an arbitrary small computation.
